name: benchDrive
description: benchDrive is a benchmark suite for evaluating autonomous driving models across realistic driving scenarios, focusing on driving policy, trajectory prediction, and closed-loop performance. It aggregates multimodal driving data and scenario-based tests to measure safety and robustness of planning and control algorithms under diverse conditions. Benchmarks report both trajectory errors and closed-loop success/failure metrics to compare learning-based and classical approaches.
reputation: A recent driving benchmark with growing interest among autonomous vehicle researchers; adoption is emerging but not yet widespread.
